# Daily with Doc — 90 for Life with Dr. Joel D. Wallach

> Your Health. Your Journey. Your Life. Discover the Power of 90 for Life! Daily with Doc is your trusted resource for empowering healthier lives through the nutritional teachings of Dr. Joel D. Wallach, BS, DVM, ND. Get Educated. Get Empowered. Get Started!

## About Dr. Joel D. Wallach
Dr. Joel D. Wallach is a veterinarian, naturopathic physician (ND), researcher, and author of the groundbreaking lecture "Dead Doctors Don't Lie". His life's work demonstrated that chronic nutritional deficiencies underlie many common degenerative conditions, and that the human body requires 90 essential nutrients daily (60 minerals, 16 vitamins, 12 amino acids, and 3 essential fatty acids) to maintain optimal health.

## Core Pillars
- **EDUCATE**: Truth-based health education decoding nutrition, mineral depletion, and biological health.
- **EVALUATE**: Finding the root nutritional cause rather than merely managing symptoms.
- **EQUIP**: Providing tools, mineral supplements, and food tracking for lasting lifestyle change.
- **EMPOWER**: Supporting continuous, minute-by-minute personal health journeys with certified Wholistic Health Coaches.

## Primary Programs & Resources
- **Live Show Broadcasts**: Monday through Friday streaming with live Q&A, case reviews, and health updates.
- **Food Diary Program**: Daily food and lifestyle tracking system to correlate nutritional intake with daily wellness.
- **Wholistic Health Coaches**: Certified health coach network assisting individuals with customized 90 for Life protocols.
- **90 Essential Nutrients**: Comprehensive supplementation including Plant Derived Minerals and Healthy Body Packs.
